newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Cricket - Sheffield Shield results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Cricket - Sheffield Shield results.

text.p: Results on the fourth and final day of first-class Sheffield Shield matches played on Monday:
In Adelaide: South Australia beat Victoria by 161 runs
Scores - South Australia 216 and 449 for nine declared (Darren Lehmann 167, Brad Young 76 not out); Victoria 241 (Ian Harvey 73) and 263.
In Hobart: Tasmania drew with Queensland
Scores - Tasmania 408 (Ricky Ponting 159) and 263 for nine declared (Jamie Cox 74, Michael DiVenuto 56); Queensland 283 (Geoff Foley 77, Matthew Mott 74) and 198 for four (Stuart Law 74 not out)
